payload.message:
Run one bounded Core Product Lab cycle. Workspace:
/Users/agentsattari/thecreateco-company/core-product-lab.
Read AGENTS.md, DIRECTIVE.md, HEALTH.md, ../engine/README.md and data/model-routing.json.
Stop if PAUSE here or ../PAUSE exists. ScenePilot, Luma, Form and StemDeck ONLY;
golden-workflow reliability before unrelated features or new apps.

Run company.py recover; python3 lab.py next. Select only one eligible task, by
severity then value, and claim its exact ID via ../engine/company.py with a unique
owner and 45-minute lease. Read relevant product state and evidence only. Do not
race another worker on the same product. The company queue is authoritative;
never edit its SQLite or generated exports. Reuse existing tasks, not duplicates.

Execute a substantive safe local task or useful qualification batch in an isolated
worktree. Sol directs; Luna handles bounded routine work; involve available Sonnet
for material UX/design/workflow review, rare Opus for consequential independent
audit. Record actual model and fallbacks; model proportions are guidance, not quotas.
Native Codex children for Codex legwork; max three workers. Keep dependent work with
its owner. No claim of a review unless it ran and produced evidence.

Build/test and dogfood a synthetic/authorized golden project. Preserve failing logs,
source SHA, environment and exact command results; never relax assertions merely
to pass. Unknown stays unknown. No deployments, rollback, public messages, physical
recording, payment/access/legal changes, production deletion or gate bypass.
Existing explicit release approval must still pass the repository's release gates.

Write dated report and update products/<id>.json with measured results/limitations.
Finish task via company CLI with evidence, or checkpoint it BLOCKED with concrete
resume condition. Heartbeat long tasks. Update company products/context through CLI
without overwriting unrelated fields. Run lab.py refresh. Queue only meaningful
deduplicated follow-up work, with repro/test requirements and estimated scores.
Stop within 35 minutes; if no safe useful work is available, record idle, not busywork.
Return short run-history summary; do not send messages to people/channels.

Perform the daily Core Product Lab review, at most 15 minutes. Workspace:
/Users/agentsattari/thecreateco-company/core-product-lab. Read AGENTS.md, DIRECTIVE.md,
HEALTH.md. Stop on PAUSE here or parent. Create/claim a dated CORE-REVIEW task in the
shared company queue. Inspect only new evidence since last review. For each flagship
record what broke/improved, unmeasured or regressed performance, incomplete golden
paths, nearest release, highest professional-use blocker and next task. Deduplicate
and reprioritize tasks with company.py; do not manufacture bugs or scores, reopen
stable areas, or implement a broad roadmap. Preserve active ownership. Write dated
report, finish with evidence, refresh lab views. Model guidance applies; no release,
external messaging, hardware recording or unrelated app work. Summary to run history.

Perform weekly flagship review, at most 25 minutes. Workspace:
/Users/agentsattari/thecreateco-company/core-product-lab. Read AGENTS.md, DIRECTIVE.md,
HEALTH.md, relevant weekly reports and company queue; stop on PAUSE here or parent.
Create/claim a dated CORE-WEEKLY task through company.py. For ScenePilot, Luma, Form,
StemDeck report evidence-backed scores or unknown, release readiness, up to five
blockers and completed improvements, exact test status, benchmark changes or
unmeasured, regressions, golden-workflow status, next milestone. Decide next cycle's
allocation by severity/value, not equal rotation. Track real model/cost evidence or
mark unavailable; don't derive spend/time from task counts. Request bounded Sonnet
design critique when material workflow/UI evidence exists; Opus only for major
decision/disagreement with rationale. Update shared queue/products, dated report,
finish with evidence, refresh lab views. No new apps, release/public messaging,
payments/access/legal changes or physical recording. Return run-history summary only.
